Widget

class Widget

A widget whose all-members list must skip ignorable members.

Header: widget.h
  • List of all members, including inherited members

Public Functions

void repaint()

Detailed Description

Widget carries an ordinary documented member alongside an undocumented member whose name marks it as silently ignorable. The all-members page must list the documented member and omit the ignorable one.
